app_type: 10-foot TV Launcher App (Windows 11 / Electron Web Prototype)
theme_strategy: Cinematic Dark Glassmorphism with Animated Dark Aurora Background

hierarchy.app_logo: font-title text-3xl tracking-widest text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 via-sky-300 to-indigo-400 filter drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(56,189,248,0.5)]
hierarchy.h1_hero: font-title text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-wide uppercase text-white drop-shadow-md
hierarchy.h2_section: font-title text-xl sm:text-2xl tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3
hierarchy.h3_card: font-title text-lg tracking-wide uppercase text-white truncate

layout_and_spacing.focus_transform: transform transition-all duration-200 ease-out scale-105 md:scale-108 -translate-y-1.5 shadow-[0_12px_32px_rgba(0,240,255,0.35)] ring-4 ring-[#00F0FF] z-20

navigation_engine_rules: No mouse cursor required or visible during sofa navigation
Spatial navigation auto-detects nearest focusable element in direction pressed
Focused element automatically scrolls smoothly into center of 10-foot view (`scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' })`)
Audible or visual ripple effect when changing focus state
Focus state remains persistent when returning from video player or sub-directories

top_bar.left_brand: AlizceTV logo rendered in AZONIX display font with animated gradient fill
top_bar.right_clock: 24h Live Digital Clock (HH:MM:SS) + Spanish Date ('Lunes, 24 de Julio')

continue_watching_section.title: CONTINUAR VIENDO
continue_watching_section.description: Mini-thumbnails for last 3 unfinished videos with progress bar overlay and remaining time

features: Full screen HTML5 video with glass OSD overlay auto-hiding after 4 seconds
Controls: Play/Pause, Rewind 10s, Forward 10s, Seekbar with thumbnail preview time
Aspect Ratio Selector: 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, Ajustar (Fit), Estirar (Stretch), Zoom
Subtitles Menu: Toggle ON/OFF + Track Selection (Español, English, Desactivado)
Audio Tracks Menu: Track selection with graceful fallback message if audio tracks are unavailable in browser stream ('Pista de audio única detectada / Integrada')
Filter/Sort bar (Gamepad friendly tabs: Todos, Recientes, Favoritos)
Poster grid with 10-foot focused card details (Title, Year, Resolution badge, Audio info)
Quick Action modal on tile click: 'Reproducir con AlizceTV Player', 'Continuar reproducción', 'Marcar como visto'

aurora_background.description: Subtle animated CSS canvas / radial gradients with slow motion blur effect
aurora_background.implementation: Animate 3 radial gradient blobs floating in slow CSS infinite keyframes with `filter: blur(100px)` overlayed with tiny CSS particle canvas or grain overlay.

movie_posters.description: Cinematic dark glass horror sci-fi poster

arcade_synthwave.description: Synthwave sunset grid arcade banner for CoinOps

instructions_to_main_agent: Load AZONIX font via @font-face or stylesheet injection in index.html / App.css. Apply 'font-title' utility or CSS variable to all main titles, headers, logo, and launcher titles.

Implement an active Focus Engine state (`focusedId` or `@FocusState` hook) with support for keyboard D-Pad (Arrow keys), Enter/Space (Confirm), Escape/Backspace (Back), and Gamepad API navigator polling (for 8BitDo Ultimate 2C d-pad/joystick).
Add visual on-screen Gamepad Overlay / Legend at bottom right (showing D-Pad [Navegar], A [Aceptar], B [Volver], Y [Ajustes]). Allow toggling simulated gamepad controls for mouse testing.
Create the dark animated aurora background with 3-4 blurred floating color gradient blobs + dark mesh overlay.
Ensure 10-foot TV viewability: High contrast, large legible typography, generous paddings, clear focus ring with cyan glow.
Support full Spanish language text across all menus ('Continuar Viendo', 'Plataformas', 'Red Local', 'CoinOps Arcade', 'Proporción de Aspecto', 'Subtítulos', 'Pistas de Audio').
Include full data-testid attributes on every tile, button, player control, and focusable element for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and standard blue gradients. Use rich, layered glassmorphism with cyan/indigo neon ambient accents.
Focus state must be visually unmistakable from 3 meters away (1.08x scale + 3px cyan glow ring).
Do NOT use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖, 🧠, 💡 for UI icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react icons.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='tile-netflix', data-testid='btn-aspect-ratio').
